title: Winey Indulgent Saudi Arabian Kabanos Sausages Kebabs
description: A winey, crumbly, indulgent Saudi Arabian dish featuring kabanos sausages, perfect for a special occasion. This dairy-free-friendly dish is sure to impress your guests.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the red wine, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the kabanos sausages onto skewers, leaving a small space between each sausage.
Brush the skewers with the wine mixture and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the sausages are browned and cooked through.
While the sausages are cooking, steam the mushrooms and onion in a steamer basket until tender.
Serve the sausages hot, garnished with the steamed mushrooms and onion.
